subject: Wave 13 adversarial review — hardened disk-read approach
hardening_vs_wave12: Wave 12 adversarial review checked policy text but did not read disk state. This review explicitly reads and counts taskcard statuses from disk before making any claims.

challenges.challenge: URL verification produced 0/22 results — could this be a false zero?
challenges.method: DISK_READ — read url-verification-results.json and check entries

disk_read.root_url_test: https://products.aspose.net/ returned HTTP 200 — site IS live

challenges.detail: The 0/22 result is genuine — not a false zero. All 22 URLs returned HTTP 403 from Cloudflare. The root URL returns 200, confirming connectivity. 403 on subpages is consistent with bot protection, not site unavailability. No registry upgrades were performed — hard constraint satisfied.

challenges.detail: 0 PENDING taskcards in Wave 12. 52 COMPLETE, 1 DEFERRED_TO_WAVE13 (W12-LD-06 — URL registry upgrade contingent on HTTP verification which was not done). Repair is confirmed on disk.
